The events GateLab draws for a pooled population

Source: R/strategy_contour.R
gatelabDisplayEvents.Rd

Picks the events a GateLab plot pooled over samples would draw: the event cap is shared between the samples in proportion to their part of the population (whole events, the remainder going to the largest fractions), and each sample's events are thinned evenly along their order in the object. Deterministic, so a plot made from the result is the same every time and shows the same events as the app.

Usage

gatelabDisplayEvents(member = NULL, sample_id, max_events = 10000)

Arguments

member

Logical vector, one value per event: the population to draw (the parent population of a gating plot). NULL takes every event.

sample_id

The sample of each event (factor or character). Samples are taken in the order of the factor's levels, or of first appearance for a character vector.

max_events

The cap on events drawn (the app's "Max events/panel"). 0 or Inf draws every event.

Value

Integer vector of event positions, sample by sample.

Details

Ported from GateLab's allocateCombinedSampleCaps() and thinEvenly(). A sample whose share of the cap rounds to nothing still gives one event, as in the app.

See also

gatelabStrategyPlot, which thins each panel's events this way.

Examples

sample_id <- rep(c("D1", "D2", "D3"), c(600, 300, 100))
keep <- gatelabDisplayEvents(NULL, sample_id, max_events = 50)
table(sample_id[keep])
#> 
#> D1 D2 D3 
#> 30 15  5
